description:
Sobre o G4 Educação

Somos o G4 Educação, somos A Evolução da Escola de Negócios.

O G4 é o lugar onde as pessoas trabalham duro para fazer do Brasil o país da prosperidade. O lugar que já gerou centenas de milhares de novos empregos por meio de seus alunos e que vai gerar pelo menos 1 milhão até 2030.

Encaramos o empreendedorismo como a maior ferramenta de transformação socioeconômica que existe e é através dela que faremos nossa revolução.

Estamos construindo uma nova geração, a geração que não pede, cria, que não espera, faz, que gera resultados para seus negócios e empregos para o país. A geração que celebra o sucesso das empresas e dos empresários porque entende que o sucesso dos negócios é o sucesso do Brasil.


Missão do Cargo

Estamos à procura de um Executivo de Vendas dinâmico e proativo, com experiência comprovada em negociar com founders, especialmente em vendas consultivas high ticket. Se você possui habilidades avançadas de comunicação e um talento especial para conduzir processos de vendas inbound, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Garantir uma experiência excepcional para os leads desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento da venda;
  • Realizar ligações e entrevistas com leads Inbound;
  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver oportunidades de vendas;
  • Realizar diagnósticos e demonstrações/apresentações de propostas comerciais;
  • Fazer follow-ups com oportunidades;
  • Negociar com os clientes e efetivar vendas;
  • Gerenciar o pipeline e forecast de vendas;
  • Adaptar-se facilmente a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e competitivo, onde a excelência e os resultados são reconhecidos e recompensados diariamente.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Conhecimento prático de CRM, preferencialmente HubSpot;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Tem inteligência emocional e está disposto a trabalhar em um ambiente que exige resiliência e aptidão a mudanças rápidas na operação;
  • Orientação para resultados e habilidades sólidas de negociação.


Informações Adicionais

Nós oferecemos:

Benefício flexível de R$ 1000,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios.

Saúde - Assistência Médica da Alice (sem coparticipação).

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: BI Developer III
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative solutions that connect millions of consumers to everyday services at more than 450,000 retail locations .


Position Summary:

The BI Developer III will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Business Intelligence solutions. This position requires strong technical expertise in data visualization, ETL processes, and database management, as well as the ability to work independently and contribute to strategic initiatives.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality reporting solutions that support business decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using Power BI , Power BI, Fabric , and SSRS .
  • Design and manage ETL processes using SSIS and ensure data integrity across large datasets.
  • Perform advanced queries and optimizations in SQL Server and work with Azure databases .
  • Create automated workflows with Power Automate to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements, assess feasibility, and estimate effort for new projects.
  • Contribute to BI strategy and roadmap, proposing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Review code and provide mentorship to junior developers.
  • Maintain the report catalog and delivery framework.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in BI development and data analysis.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI , Power Automate , Advanced Excel (including VLOOKUP), and SQL .
  • Strong experience with SSRS , SSIS , and SQL Server .
  • Experience with Azure database solutions and Power BI Fabric .
  • Knowledge of ETL principles and data modeling for rapid report generation.
  • Familiarity with source code management tools (TFS, CVS, Subversion).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications

  • QA background is a plus.
  • Experience with other visualization tools (Tableau, Crystal Reports).
  • Strong analytical mindset, proactive, and self-driven.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).


Benefits :

  • R$340 home office allowance
  • ️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)
  • 10% annual bonus
  • SulAmérica health/dental plan

title: Analista de Requisitos/Negócios SR
description:
Papel estratégico na ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, responsável por construir a visão e o roadmap da solução, maximizar o valor entregue e garantir um backlog claro, priorizado e continuamente refinado em um contexto ágil.


Atividades principais:

  • Definir e comunicar a visão e o roadmap da solução, alinhando objetivos de negócio e métricas de sucesso.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios na priorização de entregas de maior valor, com base em dados e técnicas de priorização.
  • Manter o backlog claro, organizado e continuamente refinado (histórias, critérios de aceite, dependências).
  • Conduzir discovery e elicitação de requisitos com stakeholders, transformando necessidades em especificações acionáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Análise de Negócios/Requisitos em produtos e/ou soluções digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta.
  • Domínio de técnicas e notações: elicitação, BPMN, user stories/BDD, critérios de aceite e casos de uso.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), gestão de backlog e priorização, e ferramentas como Jira/Azure DevOps.
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders; orientação a valor e métricas (OKRs/KPIs).


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Santa Catarina
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: BI Developer III
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative solutions that connect millions of consumers to everyday services at more than 450,000 retail locations .


Position Summary:

The BI Developer III will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Business Intelligence solutions. This position requires strong technical expertise in data visualization, ETL processes, and database management, as well as the ability to work independently and contribute to strategic initiatives.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality reporting solutions that support business decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using Power BI , Power BI, Fabric , and SSRS .
  • Design and manage ETL processes using SSIS and ensure data integrity across large datasets.
  • Perform advanced queries and optimizations in SQL Server and work with Azure databases .
  • Create automated workflows with Power Automate to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements, assess feasibility, and estimate effort for new projects.
  • Contribute to BI strategy and roadmap, proposing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Review code and provide mentorship to junior developers.
  • Maintain the report catalog and delivery framework.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in BI development and data analysis.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI , Power Automate , Advanced Excel (including VLOOKUP), and SQL .
  • Strong experience with SSRS , SSIS , and SQL Server .
  • Experience with Azure database solutions and Power BI Fabric .
  • Knowledge of ETL principles and data modeling for rapid report generation.
  • Familiarity with source code management tools (TFS, CVS, Subversion).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications

  • QA background is a plus.
  • Experience with other visualization tools (Tableau, Crystal Reports).
  • Strong analytical mindset, proactive, and self-driven.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).


Benefits :

  • R$340 home office allowance
  • ️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)
  • 10% annual bonus
  • SulAmérica health/dental plan

title: Analista de Requisitos/Negócios SR
description:
Papel estratégico na ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, responsável por construir a visão e o roadmap da solução, maximizar o valor entregue e garantir um backlog claro, priorizado e continuamente refinado em um contexto ágil.


Atividades principais:

  • Definir e comunicar a visão e o roadmap da solução, alinhando objetivos de negócio e métricas de sucesso.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios na priorização de entregas de maior valor, com base em dados e técnicas de priorização.
  • Manter o backlog claro, organizado e continuamente refinado (histórias, critérios de aceite, dependências).
  • Conduzir discovery e elicitação de requisitos com stakeholders, transformando necessidades em especificações acionáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Análise de Negócios/Requisitos em produtos e/ou soluções digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta.
  • Domínio de técnicas e notações: elicitação, BPMN, user stories/BDD, critérios de aceite e casos de uso.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), gestão de backlog e priorização, e ferramentas como Jira/Azure DevOps.
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders; orientação a valor e métricas (OKRs/KPIs).


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Executivo de Vendas | Closer
description:
Sobre o G4 Educação

Somos o G4 Educação, somos A Evolução da Escola de Negócios.

O G4 é o lugar onde as pessoas trabalham duro para fazer do Brasil o país da prosperidade. O lugar que já gerou centenas de milhares de novos empregos por meio de seus alunos e que vai gerar pelo menos 1 milhão até 2030.

Encaramos o empreendedorismo como a maior ferramenta de transformação socioeconômica que existe e é através dela que faremos nossa revolução.

Estamos construindo uma nova geração, a geração que não pede, cria, que não espera, faz, que gera resultados para seus negócios e empregos para o país. A geração que celebra o sucesso das empresas e dos empresários porque entende que o sucesso dos negócios é o sucesso do Brasil.


Missão do Cargo

Estamos à procura de um Executivo de Vendas dinâmico e proativo, com experiência comprovada em negociar com founders, especialmente em vendas consultivas high ticket. Se você possui habilidades avançadas de comunicação e um talento especial para conduzir processos de vendas inbound, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Garantir uma experiência excepcional para os leads desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento da venda;
  • Realizar ligações e entrevistas com leads Inbound;
  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver oportunidades de vendas;
  • Realizar diagnósticos e demonstrações/apresentações de propostas comerciais;
  • Fazer follow-ups com oportunidades;
  • Negociar com os clientes e efetivar vendas;
  • Gerenciar o pipeline e forecast de vendas;
  • Adaptar-se facilmente a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e competitivo, onde a excelência e os resultados são reconhecidos e recompensados diariamente.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Conhecimento prático de CRM, preferencialmente HubSpot;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Tem inteligência emocional e está disposto a trabalhar em um ambiente que exige resiliência e aptidão a mudanças rápidas na operação;
  • Orientação para resultados e habilidades sólidas de negociação.


Informações Adicionais

Nós oferecemos:

Benefício flexível de R$ 1000,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios.

Saúde - Assistência Médica da Alice (sem coparticipação).

️Descanso Remunerado de 30 dias após 12 meses.

title: BI Developer III
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative solutions that connect millions of consumers to everyday services at more than 450,000 retail locations .


Position Summary:

The BI Developer III will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Business Intelligence solutions. This position requires strong technical expertise in data visualization, ETL processes, and database management, as well as the ability to work independently and contribute to strategic initiatives.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality reporting solutions that support business decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using Power BI , Power BI, Fabric , and SSRS .
  • Design and manage ETL processes using SSIS and ensure data integrity across large datasets.
  • Perform advanced queries and optimizations in SQL Server and work with Azure databases .
  • Create automated workflows with Power Automate to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements, assess feasibility, and estimate effort for new projects.
  • Contribute to BI strategy and roadmap, proposing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Review code and provide mentorship to junior developers.
  • Maintain the report catalog and delivery framework.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in BI development and data analysis.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI , Power Automate , Advanced Excel (including VLOOKUP), and SQL .
  • Strong experience with SSRS , SSIS , and SQL Server .
  • Experience with Azure database solutions and Power BI Fabric .
  • Knowledge of ETL principles and data modeling for rapid report generation.
  • Familiarity with source code management tools (TFS, CVS, Subversion).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications

  • QA background is a plus.
  • Experience with other visualization tools (Tableau, Crystal Reports).
  • Strong analytical mindset, proactive, and self-driven.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).


Benefits :

  • R$340 home office allowance
  • ️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)
  • 10% annual bonus
  • SulAmérica health/dental plan

Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: BI Developer III
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative solutions that connect millions of consumers to everyday services at more than 450,000 retail locations .


Position Summary:

The BI Developer III will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining advanced Business Intelligence solutions. This position requires strong technical expertise in data visualization, ETL processes, and database management, as well as the ability to work independently and contribute to strategic initiatives.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior developers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality reporting solutions that support business decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using Power BI , Power BI, Fabric , and SSRS .
  • Design and manage ETL processes using SSIS and ensure data integrity across large datasets.
  • Perform advanced queries and optimizations in SQL Server and work with Azure databases .
  • Create automated workflows with Power Automate to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements, assess feasibility, and estimate effort for new projects.
  • Contribute to BI strategy and roadmap, proposing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Review code and provide mentorship to junior developers.
  • Maintain the report catalog and delivery framework.


Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in BI development and data analysis.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI , Power Automate , Advanced Excel (including VLOOKUP), and SQL .
  • Strong experience with SSRS , SSIS , and SQL Server .
  • Experience with Azure database solutions and Power BI Fabric .
  • Knowledge of ETL principles and data modeling for rapid report generation.
  • Familiarity with source code management tools (TFS, CVS, Subversion).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications

  • QA background is a plus.
  • Experience with other visualization tools (Tableau, Crystal Reports).
  • Strong analytical mindset, proactive, and self-driven.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).


Benefits :

  • R$340 home office allowance
  • ️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)
  • 10% annual bonus
  • SulAmérica health/dental plan

title: Analista de Requisitos/Negócios SR
description:
Papel estratégico na ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, responsável por construir a visão e o roadmap da solução, maximizar o valor entregue e garantir um backlog claro, priorizado e continuamente refinado em um contexto ágil.


Atividades principais:

  • Definir e comunicar a visão e o roadmap da solução, alinhando objetivos de negócio e métricas de sucesso.
  • Apoiar o time de negócios na priorização de entregas de maior valor, com base em dados e técnicas de priorização.
  • Manter o backlog claro, organizado e continuamente refinado (histórias, critérios de aceite, dependências).
  • Conduzir discovery e elicitação de requisitos com stakeholders, transformando necessidades em especificações acionáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Análise de Negócios/Requisitos em produtos e/ou soluções digitais, atuando de ponta a ponta.
  • Domínio de técnicas e notações: elicitação, BPMN, user stories/BDD, critérios de aceite e casos de uso.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), gestão de backlog e priorização, e ferramentas como Jira/Azure DevOps.
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders; orientação a valor e métricas (OKRs/KPIs).


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives

  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy

Platform Development

  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms

  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience

  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Software Engineer Java/Go
description:
Requisitos técnicos:

  • AWS : experiência sólida com serviços como Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SNS/SQS , além de capacidade de aprender rapidamente serviços novos (ex.: Kinesis).
  • Kotlin (versão 17) – principal linguagem utilizada em aplicações de mensageria e regras de negócio.
  • Go (Golang) – utilizada em aplicações de processo.
  • Java
  • Mensageria e Eventos : noções de Kafka (streams, consumo/produção de eventos).
  • Banco de Dados : experiência com DynamoDB .
  • Testes Automatizados : não precisa codar em Python, mas deve ter conhecimento básico para apoiar QAs em testes integrados.
  • Observabilidade : experiência com interpretação de logs, monitoração e troubleshooting .
  • Ferramentas de Observabilidade/Diferenciais : conhecimento em CloudWatch e Datadog (forte diferencial).


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Não apenas implementamos software; transformamos negócios e os ajudamos a escalar. Para continuar esta missão, buscamos incorporar ao nosso time Consultores(as) ERP Sênior de alto calibre.


Sua Missão como Consultor(a) ERP Sênior:


Você será peça-chave na otimização dos processos de negócio de nossos clientes através da implementação e consultoria especializada em soluções ERP. Seu conhecimento em sistemas como SAP (Business One, S/4HANA), Microsoft Dynamics (AX, NAV, 365), Oracle (EBS, JD Edwards) ou, idealmente, Oracle NetSuite, será fundamental para desenhar e implementar soluções que gerem impacto real.


O Que Esperamos de Você?


  • Domínio Comprovado em ERPs (+5 anos Implementando ERPs): Precisamos da sua experiência tangível no ciclo completo de projetos ERP: desde a análise de necessidades, design da solução, configuração, até a implantação e o suporte pós-implementação. Não basta conhecer a teoria; buscamos resultados comprovados.
  • Visão de Negócio: Você entenderá os desafios e objetivos de negócio dos nossos clientes para traduzir suas necessidades em soluções ERP funcionais e eficientes que agreguem valor quantificável.
  • Capacidade de Execução: Liderará e executará projetos de implementação, assegurando a qualidade, o cumprimento de prazos e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Comunicação Direta e Eficaz: Você se comunicará com clareza e precisão tanto com as equipes técnicas quanto com os níveis diretivos dos nossos clientes.
  • Inglês Avançado Indispensável: A interação com equipes e documentação internacional é constante. Um nível de inglês avançado, tanto oral quanto escrito, é um fator determinante para o sucesso nesta posição.


O Que Você Terá ao se Juntar à LatamReady?


  • A oportunidade de trabalhar com empresas líderes e em crescimento em toda a região.
  • Projetos desafiadores que permitirão aplicar sua expertise e gerar um impacto real.
  • Ser parte de uma organização focada na excelência, com um profundo conhecimento de Oracle NetSuite e do mercado latino-americano.
  • Um ambiente onde sua contribuição direta para o sucesso de nossos clientes é o principal indicador de seu desempenho.
  • Compensação competitiva e desenvolvimento profissional na principal solução Cloud ERP do mundo.


Se você é um(a) Consultor(a) ERP com profundo conhecimento em sistemas ERP, clara orientação a resultados, domina o inglês em nível avançado e está pronto(a) para levar sua carreira ao próximo nível em um ambiente dinâmico e focado, esta é sua oportunidade!

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

• Full stack development experience (e.g. React or some other front-end framework, APIs, GraphQL and backends such as NodeJS, Drupal, etc)

• Experience working in agile teams (Scrum Preferred, Kanban sufficient)

• Hands on experience with Auth0

• Experience working with Jira

Bonus

Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Automation Anywhere
description:
RPA Automatização - III

Sobre a NEC:

Fundada no Japão em 1898 e com mais de 100.000 colaboradores em todo mundo, a NEC é uma das maiores provedoras globais de soluções integradas de Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação e está presente no mercado latino-americano desde 1968.

Atuante em várias vertentes do mercado tecnológico, a NEC tem como missão ser uma empresa especializada em soluções e serviços end-to-end, que vão desde o fundo do oceano até o espaço sideral. Operando no setor público e privado, a multinacional combina inovação, qualidade e confiabilidade em soluções personalizadas de acordo com as necessidades de seus clientes.

NEC cria os valores sociais de proteção, segurança, igualdade e eficiência para promover um mundo mais sustentável, onde todos tenham a oportunidade de alcançar seu potencial máximo.

Por que trabalhar na NEC?

A NEC é grande família que valoriza a qualidade humana e o respeito acima de tudo. Estamos constantemente preocupados com o desenvolvimento daqueles que fazem parte do nosso time, oferecendo ferramentas que contribuem para o aprendizado de habilidades que vão além do ambiente corporativo.

Nossa equipe se orgulha de sua pluralidade cultural e reconhece que a importância da diversidade para a criação de um clima organizacional transparente e motivador que incentiva todos a serem a sua melhor versão.

Pensando no crescimento daqueles que fazer parte da nossa equipe, apostamos na inovação e na capacitação para incentivar a criação de líderes que estão dispostos a sair de suas zonas de conforto para agregar valor à sociedade.

Venha fazer parte desta equipe!

Descrição do Cargo:

RPA Automação experiência prática em desenvolvimento de RPA utilizando o Automation Anywhere A360, com sólido conhecimento de templates e melhores práticas.

Local de Trabalho: Híbrido – São Paulo

Horário de Trabalho: 09h00 as 18h00

Principais Atividades:

Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de RPA com o Automation Anywhere A360 para automatizar processos de negócios.

• Colaborar diretamente com as partes interessadas do negócio para identificar, definir e refinar os requisitos de automação, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos de negócios.

• Criar e manter documentação técnica abrangente, incluindo documentos de design de processos, arquiteturas de soluções e componentes reutilizáveis.

• Monitorar, solucionar problemas e otimizar continuamente as soluções de RPA existentes para garantir a eficiência operacional e a escalabilidade.

• Realizar testes e validações rigorosos para garantir a precisão, a qualidade e o desempenho dos processos automatizados.

• Fornecer suporte ao usuário final, garantindo uma implementação e adoção tranquilas.

• Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de RPA, mantendo altos padrões de controle de versão, segurança e desempenho.

• Conhecimento de SQL, Visual Basic Scripting e Python; experiência com Java é um diferencial.

• Fortes habilidades de comunicação e profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócios de ponta a ponta.

• Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes regionais em ambiente de trabalho remoto.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

Superior Completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia e ou areas correlatas

Habilidades Técnicas: Automation Anywhere A360, Visual Basic Scripting e Python.

Habilidades Interpessoais: Trabalho em equipe, comunicação e resolução de problemas.

Diferenciais:

Conhecimentos em Java, SAP ERP

VR ou VA
